target.title: Expose startup channel maintenance doctor findings
target.body:
## Summary
- add default-disabled `core/doctor/startup-channel-maintenance` structured findings under the existing startup-channel-maintenance Doctor contribution
- map read-only channel doctor preview warnings into stable health findings with `channels.*` paths and `doctor --fix` guidance
- leave real startup maintenance mutation in the existing repair-only `doctor --fix` path; lint does not run channel startup lifecycle hooks

## Public surface
- No public SDK/plugin/config contract changes.
- Default `doctor --lint` is unchanged; this check runs with `--only core/doctor/startup-channel-maintenance` or `--all`.

## PR surface
- 4 files changed, +191/-13 from `main`.

## Validation
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/flows/doctor-startup-channel-maintenance.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts` (63 tests)
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/flows/doctor-startup-channel-maintenance.ts src/flows/doctor-startup-channel-maintenance.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `pnpm exec oxlint src/flows/doctor-startup-channel-maintenance.ts src/flows/doctor-startup-channel-maintenance.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.mjs --check`
- `git diff --check`
